reference_prolog:
% Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
% State: Kansas
% Focus year: 2021
% Question: Are eviction cases first heard in district court?

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Scenario facts (encode the question's factual statement)
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

% We model a representative eviction case in Kansas in 2021.
scenario_state(kansas).
scenario_year(2021).

% A representative case
scenario_case(case1).
scenario_case_type(case1, eviction).
scenario_case_location(case1, kansas).

% We treat eviction as a landlord-tenant action governed by the Kansas Residential
% Landlord and Tenant Act for purposes of applying KS Stat  58-2542.
scenario_governed_by_act(case1, ks_residential_landlord_tenant_act).

% The statement in reusable logical form:
% "There is an eviction case in Kansas (focus year 2021)."
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(kansas),
    scenario_year(2021),
    scenario_case(Case),
    scenario_case_type(Case, eviction),
    scenario_case_location(Case, kansas),
    scenario_governed_by_act(Case, ks_residential_landlord_tenant_act).

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Statute translation (deterministic predicates capturing KS Stat  58-2542)
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

% KS Stat  58-2542 (2021): "The district court shall have jurisdiction over any
% landlord or tenant with respect to any conduct in this state governed by this act
% or with respect to any claim arising from a transaction subject to this act..."
%
% We encode the core jurisdictional rule as a deterministic predicate:
% legal_district_court_has_jurisdiction_over_action(Action, State, Year).
legal_district_court_has_jurisdiction_over_action(Action, State, Year) :-
    nonvar(Action),
    nonvar(State),
    nonvar(Year),
    statute_58_2542_applies(Year),
    action_in_state(Action, State),
    action_governed_by_act(Action, ks_residential_landlord_tenant_act),
    !.

% The statute is provided for focus_year 2021; we treat it as applicable in 2021.
statute_58_2542_applies(Year) :-
    integer(Year),
    Year =:= 2021,
    !.

% Helper: action_in_state/2 and action_governed_by_act/2 derive from scenario facts.
action_in_state(Action, State) :-
    scenario_case(Action),
    scenario_case_location(Action, State),
    !.

action_governed_by_act(Action, Act) :-
    scenario_case(Action),
    scenario_governed_by_act(Action, Act),
    !.

% KS Stat  58-2542 (2021) also says such actions "may be commenced" pursuant to the
% code of civil procedure for limited actions (in district court, given jurisdiction).
%
% We model "first heard" as "commenced in" (i.e., the initial court of filing/hearing).
legal_proper_initial_court(Action, State, Year, district_court) :-
    legal_district_court_has_jurisdiction_over_action(Action, State, Year),
    !.

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Reasoning specific to the question
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

% The question asks generally about eviction cases; we answer based on whether, in the
% scenario, an eviction case would be properly commenced (first heard) in district court.
eviction_cases_first_heard_in_district_court :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_case(Case),
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_year(Year),
    scenario_case_type(Case, eviction),
    legal_proper_initial_court(Case, State, Year, district_court),
    !.

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% housing_answer(Result): must be deterministic and yield yes/no
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    eviction_cases_first_heard_in_district_court,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Main entrypoint (required)
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Are eviction cases first heard in district court?
